title: Temporal invalidation topology
question: Does a time-local edit invalidate only its dependency footprint rather than the entire downstream node/frame range?

environment.notes: Run cold-cache and warm-cache variants separately.

hypotheses.prediction: Invalidation remains bounded near changed temporal support.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Unaffected distant frames consistently lose reusable state after a local edit.

hypotheses.prediction: Any semantic edit broadly invalidates downstream cached frames.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Distant frames remain provably reusable after isolated local edits.

factors: name-only edit with and without expression dependency
procedure: Create deterministic 300-frame fixture and warm relevant caches.
Apply one isolated mutation per run.
Re-request fixed near and distant frame sets without other edits.
Preserve trace/log/raw fingerprints and environment metadata.
